name: 3G
source:
3G is a three-headed youkai who has been working as a Karou (chief official/adviser) for many years in the Oda Family. 3G particularly likes to dote on Kouhime who he sees as an important successor of the Oda Family.

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/3G]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
